## Brand Strategy
- No formal brand strategy section. The document is a practical usage guide focused on logo and trademark rules.
- The logo is described as "a powerful symbol for what's happening in the world now, and the power of the voices and unique conversations that happen on the platform everyday."

## Logo
- The Twitter bird is the sole logo mark.
- **Color rules:** Only Twitter blue or white. No other colors permitted.
- **Strict prohibitions:** No alteration, rotation, modification. No animation, no anthropomorphizing, no accessories (speech bubbles, etc.), no creatures surrounding it.
- **Social icon variants:** Free-standing bird preferred; circle, square, or rounded-square containers permitted. Minimum width 32px for all social icon variants.
- **Misuse examples (10 shown):** No outlines, no drop shadows, no special effects, no gradients, no multi-color fills, no skewing/rotating/stretching, no orientation changes, no added elements, no anatomy additions, no multiplication.
- Clear space guidance included.

- Not covered in sampled pages (document is only 14 pages total and focused on logo/trademark).

## Color
- Twitter blue is the primary brand color (specific values not in sampled text, but referenced as the only approved logo color alongside white).

## Graphics / Iconography
- Not covered beyond the bird logo.

## Photography / Imagery
- Not covered.

## Applications
- Social media icon usage across platforms.
- Embedded Tweets, Timelines, and Buttons (references publish.twitter.com).
- Merchandise rules: no use of name/logo on merchandise unless locked up with a #Hashtag or @Username, or alongside other social icons.
- Books/publications: must be "about Twitter, not by Twitter."

## Tone of Voice / Verbal Identity
- Trademark naming rules: always capitalize the T in "Twitter" and all noun/verb versions of "Tweet" and "Retweet."
- The "Twitter marks" include the name, logo, and the term "Tweet."

## Outliers / Noteworthy Details
- Very concise document (14 pages) -- essentially a logo usage and trademark compliance guide rather than full brand guidelines.
- Pre-Elon Musk acquisition; this represents the classic bird-era Twitter brand.
- Heavy legal/trademark section occupies the final pages.
- Presentation format (1920 x 1080 pts).
- References brand.twitter.com for downloadable Starter Kit.
